architecture.activation_token: 256-bit cryptographically random; single-use; 30-minute expiry; SHA-256 hash stored; re-issue rotates token; atomic redemption
architecture.activation: password set through ASP.NET Core Identity; email confirmed atomically; no application session issued; user must sign in and enroll MFA before V41 first-Owner provisioning
architecture.database_provisioner_role: atendee_identity_provisioner login; NOINHERIT, NOSUPERUSER, NOBYPASSRLS; SET only to atendee_identity_owner
architecture.activation_token_permissions: auth login SELECT plus column-level UPDATE only on ConsumedAtUtc; cannot insert or rotate tokens
architecture.aws_credentials: AWS SDK provider chain; prefer IAM roles or temporary federated credentials; no long-lived secrets in source
architecture.activation_url: token carried in URL fragment; frontend strips fragment and posts token with antiforgery
